body.segment: The authors study at the density-functional theory level the modification of the electronic structure of the ITO surface upon self-assembly of a monolayer of t-butyl carbazole-substituted phosphonic acid molecules and subsequent p-doping.
The results of the calculations point to the existence of two channels for charge transfer.
These channels can enhance hole injection between ITO and a hole-transport overlayer through the chemically-modified interface.
